generation.prompt: Create a high quality Kalistar game faction banner TEXTURE, flat frontal textile artwork for a very narrow portrait hanging pennant. Aspect ratio 1:2.3, ideally 896 x 2048. No background scene, no pole, no perspective, no outside border or margin. Deep midnight teal woven silk fills the complete rectangular image, restrained aged brass and ivory embroidery. Main emblem in the upper-middle: an elegant eight-point compass rosette, one circular ring with eight slender paths radiating outward, a small warm ivory star in the center. The emblem must be geometrically round, broad and readable, occupying 70 percent of image width; no stretching. Just above the emblem two clear small stacked lines of elegant ivory serif capitals, exact text 'OCTOPATH' then 'TRAVELER'. Below the emblem, eight tiny simple gold traveller silhouettes crossing one quiet horizontal line, suggest a shared journey without dense detail. Mostly dark textile at top and bottom so it works in a native card flag. Copper-gold fine double woven side edging. Premium painted digital fantasy material consistent with Kalistar, not photo, not glossy 3D, not a game screenshot, not a full character card. High contrast and clean limited motifs legible when reduced to 98 x 223 pixels. No additional words, numbers, icons, flags or UI.
